verdict.rationale: The story asks whether Gemini CLI publishes llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs that a user can point an agent at. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.google.com/llms.txt), and nothing else in the pack documents agent-oriented docs. GEMINI.md context files and Google Search grounding are adjacent features of the agent itself, not machine-readable docs about the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
